messages:
Maya: Heads-up team — planning a 2h quiet window for the release handoff today starting 14:00 UTC. Please put any non-blocking work on hold and focus on merge checks/QA.

Tom: On it. I'll finish the last round of PR reviews and merge #4321 and #4330 before the window. Expect ~15m of scoping for the DB migration.

Irene: Docs checklist: I pushed changelog entries for the public API changes to `docs/changelog/v0.22.0.md`. Can someone double-check the compatibility note? Link: https://git.company/repo/PR/444

Sam: QA smoke plan posted in the test board. Quick summary: basic chat flow, embeddings sanity, and load-check at 100 rps. I'll run the smoke suite 10m after merges.

Maya: Security: @Tom please confirm that the new auth header is covered by the security review checklist. If not, we need a quick sign-off from infra-security.

Tom: Security checklist: auth header change is in PR #4330, I've added the security tag and the minimal threat model. pinging infra-security for sign-off now.

qa-bot: Smoke suite queued by Sam. Run ID: smoke-2026-05-15-09. Will post results in ~8m.

Irene: Quick doc ask — also updated the example snippet for the new param. Please look at the `examples/` code block; it now shows `timeout_ms` default behavior.

Sam: smoke-2026-05-15-09 completed: 3 failed (minor timeout flake on upstream), 42 passed. Logging into the failures now.

Tom: Re: failures — looks like a flaky external dependency. I pushed a retry wrapper to #4331, will rerun smoke after merge.

Maya: Version bump reminder — please standardize on `v0.22.0` in package.json and the helm chart before closing the release PR.

Tom: Done. package.json bumped and helm values updated. PR #4332 contains the bump.

Irene: Docs double-checked and approved. :thumbsup: Small wording tweak in the migration note, committed.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 14:20 UTC to `canary-us-west`. Canaries: 1x small, 2m window, health probes every 10s.

Maya: Final sign-offs: @Tom (eng), @Sam (QA), @Irene (docs). Please react with :white_check_mark: when ready.

Tom: :white_check_mark: merged all PRs (4321, 4330, 4332).

Sam: :white_check_mark: QA green after retry. All critical smoke tests passed.

Irene: :white_check_mark: docs published and changelog entry ready.

Maya: Great — starting the quiet window and kicking off the canary. If anything blocks, add to this thread. Otherwise we'll promote after the 2m canary window. :rocket:
